units: <cite ref="Shabbat 122a:10">Sabb. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>מותר לִרְחוֹץ בה מיד</he> it is permitted to bathe in it immediately (after the exit of the Sabbath); ib. 151ᵃ; <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 2:5">Makhsh. II, 5</cite> <he>רוֹחֵץ מיד</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 15a:3">Ber. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שאין … לרחוץ ידיו</he> (Ms. M. <he>ליטול</he>) he that has no water with which to wash his hands (before prayer).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:6">Tosef. Keth. VII, 6</cite> <he>ורוֹחֶצֶת במרחץ עם כל אדם</he> a woman that bathes in a bath-house with all kind of people (loses her jointure). Y. ib. VII, 31ᵇ bot. (as a case for divorce) <he>הדירה שלא תִרְחֲצִי וכ׳</he> if he bound her by a vow (saying), thou shalt not bathe in a bath-house; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="T00486"><he>רָחוּץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 17b:7">Zeb. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא רְחוּץ ידים וכ׳</he> not having washed his hands and feet (before a sacred function); <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 1:9">Tosef. Men. I, 9</cite>.

senses.gloss: same, to wash, cleanse. Ib. 10 משפשף ומַרְחִיץ he rubs and washes (hands and feet). Ber. l. c. (ref. to Ps. XXVI, 6) דכתיב אֶרְחַץ ולא אַרְחִיץ (v. Ms. M., Rabb. D. S. a. l.) it is written erḥats (I bathe), and not arḥits (I cleanse), i.e. washing of hands as a symbolical act is equal to immersion. Y. Keth. V, 30ᵃ bot. ומַרְחֶצֶת לו וכ׳ she must bathe his feet (personally attend to his foot-bath).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:3">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>שמַרְחִיצִין את ישראל וכ׳</he> who cleanse Israel from sins; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13<sup>2</sup></cite> <he>עתיד … ולהַרְחִיצָם בנחלי חלב</he> the Lord shall cause them to drink …, and to bathe in rivers of milk. Sabb. l. c.; Makhsh. l. c. <he>מרחץ המרחצת בשבת</he> a bath-house that allows bathing (is heated and open) on the Sabbath. Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ bot. <he>מרחץ ואע״פ שאינה מרחצת</he> a bath-house, even if it is not in use.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>שהיו כולן מר׳ מן העונות</he> they were all cleansed of their sins.

senses.gloss: to be cleansed. Yalk. Cant. l. c. שהטיף … ונִרְחֲצוּ מעונותיהם the Lord dropped dew upon them, and they were cleansed of their sins.
